title: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark: A Benchmark for Evaluating Clinical Reasoning Capabilities in ECG Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2603.14326v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promising performance in automated electrocardiogram interpretation, it remains unclear whether they perform actual step-by-step reasoning or just rely on superficial visual cues. To investigate this, we introduce ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark, a novel multi-turn evaluation framework comprising over 6,400 samples to systematically assess step- by-step reasoning across 17 core ECG diagnoses. Our comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a systematic shortfall in executing multi-step logical deduction. Although models possess the medical knowledge to retrieve clinical criteria for a diagnosis, they exhibit consistently low success rates in maintaining a complete reasoning chain, primarily failing to ground the corresponding ECG findings to the actual visual evidence in the ECG signal. translated_title: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark：一个用于评估心电图解读中临床推理能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在自动化心电图解读方面展现出有前景的表现，但尚不清楚它们是进行真正的逐步推理，还是仅仅依赖表面的视觉线索。为了探究这一问题，我们提出了ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark，这是一个新颖的多轮评估框架，包含超过6,400个样本，用于系统评估17种核心心电图诊断中的逐步推理能力。我们对最先进模型的全面评估揭示了它们在执行多步骤逻辑推演方面存在系统性缺陷。尽管模型具备检索诊断所需临床标准的医学知识，但它们在维持完整推理链方面的成功率始终较低，主要失败于将相应的心电图发现与心电图信号中的实际视觉证据进行关联。这些结果表明，当前的多模态大语言模型绕过了实际的视觉解读过程。
tldr: 该论文提出了ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark多轮评估框架（含6,400多个样本、覆盖17种核心心电图诊断），系统评估揭示当前多模态大语言模型虽具备医学知识，但在心电图解读中缺乏真正的逐步推理能力，无法将推理链与实际视觉证据建立关联。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark, a multi-turn evaluation framework with over 6,400 samples across 17 core ECG diagnoses, revealing that current MLLMs, despite possessing medical knowledge, systematically fail to maintain complete reasoning chains and cannot ground their reasoning in actual visual evidence of ECG signals.
